raw_block.rationale: Create a compact NDA classifier around one coupled disclosure-and-disposition record. The procedure captures the TRAIN distinction between an unqualified all-material return duty and a selective return framework that expressly preserves derivative or oral information.

inputs.name: statement_kind
inputs.question: Which current NDA proposition is being tested: employee_sharing, representative_sharing, termination_return_or_destroy, or post_disposition_retention?

skill.intent: Classify recurring NDA statements about employee disclosure, representative disclosure, disposition duties, and retention after disposition.

outputs.description: One native ContractNLI label: Entailment, Contradiction, or NotMentioned.
outputs.name: answer
